name: session-audit
description: Out-of-cycle, read-only cost and efficiency audit of Claude Code sessions that ran agile-skills: per-skill and per-subagent spend, a before/after delta normalised by work shipped, and ranked improvements.

interface.shortDescription: Measure what a session cost and what it shipped.
interface.longDescription: Profile Claude Code session transcripts per skill and subagent, compare two runs normalised by work shipped, and rank the edits that would cut spend.
defaultPrompt: Audit the cost of my last session.
